meta.title: dsh-subor-startup
meta.description: Subor-style CRT boot animation for DeepSeek Harness — the tube powers on, the pixel logo drops in with a line of "DeepSeek, endless fun", then 108 classic FC game windows fill the screen along a snake-like inward spiral, before a white flash fades into the app. Auto-plays, skippable, zero config.
